articles.title: My Morning Routine
articles.content:
I get up at half past six every morning. First, I wash my face and brush my teeth. Then I drink a glass of warm water. My mother makes breakfast for the family. We usually have eggs, bread and milk.

At seven o'clock, I put on my school uniform and pack my schoolbag. I check my timetable to make sure I have all my books. I leave home at twenty past seven and walk to school with my friend Ben. The walk takes about fifteen minutes. We talk about football and films on the way.

School starts at eight o'clock. Before the first class, I often read English aloud for ten minutes. It helps me remember new words. I like my quiet mornings because they make me feel ready for the day.

articles.title: A Trip to the City Park
articles.content:
Last Saturday, the weather was fine, so my family went to the city park. We took the bus because the park is a little far from our home. In the park, many people were enjoying the sunshine. Some children were flying kites, and some old people were dancing to music near the lake.

My little sister wanted to see the ducks, so we bought a bag of bread and fed them by the water. The ducks swam quickly to us and ate all the bread. Then we walked along a small river. There were many beautiful flowers next to the path, and my father took a lot of photos of us.

At noon, we sat on the grass and had a picnic. Mum made sandwiches and Dad made tea. After lunch, I played badminton with my sister. We went home at four o'clock in the afternoon. We were all tired but very happy. I hope we can go again next weekend.

articles.title: My Best Friend Lisa
articles.content:
I have many friends at school, but my best friend is Lisa. We have known each other since Grade Three. Lisa is tall and has short black hair. She wears glasses because she reads a lot. She is the top student in our class, but she is never proud.

When I have problems with my homework, she always explains everything slowly until I understand. Lisa also loves sports. She plays table tennis very well and taught me how to play last term. Now we play together every Friday afternoon.

Lisa wants to be a doctor in the future because she wants to help sick people. I think she will make her dream come true, because she studies hard and never gives up. A friend like Lisa is like a light in my life. I hope we will be friends forever.

articles.title: Making Dumplings with Grandma
articles.content:
Last Friday evening, my grandma taught me how to make dumplings. First, we made the dough with flour and water. Grandma said the dough must rest for half an hour. While we waited, we prepared the filling with pork, cabbage and onions. Grandma cut everything into small pieces and mixed them in a big bowl.

Then she showed me how to roll the wrappers. My first wrapper was too thick and looked like a small map. Grandma laughed and showed me again. Slowly, my wrappers got better. The most difficult part was closing the dumplings. My first one opened in the boiling water! But by the end, I made twenty dumplings, and only two of them broke.

When the dumplings were ready, the whole family ate together. My parents said my dumplings tasted great. I felt proud of myself. Making dumplings is not easy, but it is really fun.

articles.title: My Cat Mimi
articles.content:
Mimi is my cat. She is two years old and has white fur with black ears. My aunt gave her to me on my tenth birthday. Mimi sleeps a lot during the day. Her favourite place is the sofa near the window, where she can watch birds outside.

But when I come home from school, she always runs to the door and makes small sounds, as if she is saying hello. Mimi loves fish best. Every Sunday, Mum buys a small fish for her, and Mimi waits by her bowl long before dinner. She is also very clean. She washes her face with her paw many times a day.

Sometimes Mimi is naughty. Last week, she pushed my cup off the desk and broke it. I was angry, but when she looked at me with her big eyes, I could not stay angry. I love Mimi, and I think she loves me too.

articles.title: A Rainy Sunday
articles.content:
It was Sunday, but it rained heavily all day. We could not go out, so we stayed at home. At first, I felt bored and watched the rain run down the window. Then Mum had a good idea. Why don't we make a cake?

We found flour, sugar, eggs and milk in the kitchen. Dad helped us mix everything, and I beat the eggs. Mum said beating eggs was the most important step. We put the mixture into the oven and waited. The whole house smelled wonderful.

While we waited, we played a card game at the table. Dad told us stories about his childhood, and we laughed a lot. Finally, the cake was ready. It was not as beautiful as the cakes in the shop, but it tasted delicious. The rain did not stop all day, but we had a wonderful time at home. Sometimes a rainy day can be a happy day.

articles.title: The School Library
articles.content:
Our school library is a quiet and bright place. It is on the second floor of the red building. There are more than twenty thousand books in it, and new books arrive every month. The library has two big rooms. In one room, there are long tables where students can read and do homework. In the other room, there are bookshelves full of books about science, history, art and sports.

My favourite corner is near the window, because the light is good and I can see the trees outside. Students can borrow three books each time and keep them for two weeks. If you need more time, you can renew them online. Miss Gao, the librarian, is kind and helpful. She always knows where to find the books we need.

I go to the library three times a week. Reading there after class makes me calm and happy. Books are like friends to me.

articles.title: Shopping for a Jacket
articles.content:
Winter was coming, so Mum took me to the shopping centre to buy a new jacket. There were so many shops and clothes that I did not know where to start. In the first shop, I saw a blue jacket. It looked cool, but it was too expensive. It cost eight hundred yuan! Mum said we could find something just as good for less money.

In the next shop, I tried on a black jacket. It was warm, but the sleeves were too long, and I looked like I was wearing my father's clothes. Finally, in the third shop, I found a green jacket in the sale. It fitted me well and cost only two hundred and sixty yuan. Mum said green was a good colour for me. I looked in the mirror and agreed.

We also bought a warm scarf. On the way home, I wore my new jacket, and I felt like the happiest boy in the world.

articles.title: My Favorite Season
articles.content:
Of all the four seasons, autumn is my favourite. The weather in autumn is neither too hot nor too cold. The sky is often blue and clear, and a cool wind makes people feel comfortable.

Autumn is also the season of colours. The leaves turn yellow, orange and red, and they fall from the trees like butterflies. Our school looks beautiful in October. After class, I often take a walk and enjoy the falling leaves. Autumn is the harvest season, too. Farmers are busy in the fields, and the markets are full of fresh fruit. My favourite fruits, pears and grapes, are sweetest at this time of year.

There is also an important festival in autumn, the Mid-Autumn Festival. My family get together, eat mooncakes and enjoy the full moon. Some people like spring because everything begins to grow, but I love autumn best. To me, autumn means harvest, beauty and family time.

articles.title: A Phone Call to Grandpa
articles.content:
Grandpa lives in a small village far from the city, so I cannot see him often. Every Sunday evening, I call him and we talk for about half an hour. Yesterday, I called him as usual. He told me that the rice in the fields was growing well and that he had picked fresh vegetables in the morning.

He asked me about my school life. I told him I got full marks in the maths test. Grandpa was so happy that he laughed like a child. Then he told me an old story about the village, the same story he tells every time, but I never get tired of it. Before we said goodbye, he reminded me to eat well and sleep early, and I asked him not to work too hard in the fields.

After the call, I felt warm. Although we are far from each other, our hearts are close. I am going to visit him during the winter holiday.
